question: Does learning at the exact histories and first visible token mistakes generated by the recurrent student improve grounded open answers across complete new human tables and linked articles, while preserving practical decisions?
protocol: Only if the earlier completed direct preference pair misses its joint promotion gate. Fresh native release 05 two-visit initialization, shared rank 32 in seven last-layer projections. Independent intervention: train on the student's actual visited histories. At initialization and after 400 updates freely generate up to three 192-token turns on 64 different training articles per stage, one version per article, balanced inline/file. Record every token, action, real observation and physical history. Independently re-execute the calls. At each wrong decision use the published linked row and article or human answer to supervise the next relevant action. For completed student reasoning preserve those actual tokens unchanged as conditioning context and place no imitation loss on them. At the first divergent visible token contrast the correct token against the student's actual emitted token, with an absolute margin and a margin relative to the stop-gradient first visit. For those corrections use 40% full/semantic positive loss, 30% divergent-token CE, 15% softplus(1-gold/competitor logit gap) and 15% softplus(.35+one-visit gap-two-visit gap). Other turns use 40% whole-sequence and 60% post-thinking CE. Each AdamW step samples one correction (40% weight), one canonical action (20%), one source-quoted answer (25%) and one former real task (15%). Aggregate both rounds at the midpoint. 800 updates in total, lr=.00007, no model routing, constrained decoding or injected golden observations at evaluation. Training sources: 128 human HybridQA train articles, both views, 320 protected executable/reading turns. Qualification: verified 24 new articles, frozen 84 prompts/actual files and at least 12 distinct actual learner errors per collection. If insufficient, close without further training or evaluation.
decision: Direct candidate/untouched BF16 Qwen Base pair, identical initial IDs, greedy thinking, up to three 512-token turns. 24 original unedited ordinary human questions in both full-inline-table+article-file and table-file+article-file presentations. A successful answer requires completed SQuAD-normalized exact match, the actual required source article and, for file-table mode, the preceding actual hyperlink from the table. Other valid keys exposing the same source link count. Require >=12/48 grounded, >=8 net additional, exact two-sided sign-flip by whole article p<=.05, >=3 whole questions and strictly more than Base, strict gains in both views and in mean open-answer token F1. Separately retain every Base success on 36 input-selected older cases (two complete human tables, four wheel pairs, four agenda pairs, eight old table questions). Require >=2/4 whole opposing pairs and more than Base in each practical domain, no lower completion in any family, strictly lower total wall, summed first wait and peak, and strictly higher prompt and decode rates. Record all individual additions/losses. If the full pair passes, compare the same curriculum against matched K1 with float precision, samples, optimization exposure and data fixed; then qualify that single installation with complete real 131K inputs and multi-domain regression. A failure closes those downstream tests for these weights. No general quality claim from training losses, existing holdouts or the separate release05 long-context measurement.
source_recovery: The first collection stopped before any optimizer updates or held generations when two page IDs resolved to the identical article. Preserve every original held byte, case, output cap and decision threshold. Replace the entire offending training source with the next admissible original source in hash order. Check all original text on both sides; reject any shared target ID, identical normalized article, complete answer sentence or counterpart sharing at least 80% of target 5-grams. Restart from release 05 with fresh weights, trajectories, optimizer and budget. The disqualified collection supplies no training input or model scores.
